title: Brother Yusuf
_note: Saltreach, by the shrine. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

idle.speaker: Brother Yusuf
idle.text: Tu'whacca keep you. Are you here for a blessing, or to tell me something I'd rather not know? People mostly do the second.

choices.text: Do you know anything about the Kesh?

bless.speaker: Brother Yusuf
bless.text: [He touches your forehead with two fingers and salt water.] Keeper of the Far Shores, see this one home. [You feel steadier.]

kesh.speaker: Brother Yusuf
kesh.text: [He looks round.] I know they give to the shrine. More than anyone. I know I take it. I know I should not. Please don't ask me more in the street.

burned.speaker: Brother Yusuf
burned.text: I heard. I'm so sorry. Zeyna would not let me do the rites, she said she'd do them herself, properly. She did. I watched.

count.speaker: Brother Yusuf
count.text: Count them? Three. A small one, a long one, and... [He frowns.] The third was too long for a child. I thought it was strange. I didn't say anything. I never do.
